harness.name: check-source.mjs

steps: Create a fresh audit directory beneath the repository .work/gap-validation. Materialize replay.harness sourceText there, checking recorded SHA256 values.

git archive --format=tar --output=<audit>/source.tar b776be5fc8bb8fd04d9a6ef2846eaf61bac8f4f0 <the nine source.start.files paths>; extract into <audit>/source. Run check-source.mjs start from repository root.

Within WSL, use Node 22 and /usr/bin/cc: node source/packages/cli/scripts/build-linux-subreaper.mjs --out helper-build --commit b776be5fc8bb8fd04d9a6ef2846eaf61bac8f4f0. Set TMPDIR to a directory inside the audit directory.

Use the captured build.sh as command reference, replacing its audit-directory and dependency-tool locations if necessary; pkg 6.21.0 and esbuild-wasm 0.28.1 must resolve from the repository node_modules. Build all five variants. Run make-patches.cjs and check-source.mjs end.

On a disposable Linux x64 host with /usr/bin/node, create a unique /tmp/cc-standalone-b776be5fc8-XXXXXXXX directory. Copy the valid variant cc-helper-probe-pack as valid, plus patches.json and run-remote.cjs. Run /usr/bin/node <unique-directory>/run-remote.cjs.

Read probe-results.json and compare every remote binary hash with the corresponding local full binary. Expect valid exit 0 and all four faults exit 3. Rebuilt binary hashes may differ with build tool/runtime provenance; recheck internally rather than treating recorded hashes as universal reproducibility.

limitations: Independent supplementary helper-entry probe, not a packaged full-CLI smoke test or GitHub Actions release gate.
Only Linux x64 was built and executed; no Linux ARM64, Windows, or macOS native validation is claimed.
Canonical node22-linux-x64 target exercised here; target aliases and empty-target rejection require the separate unit/CI results.
Pinned-image execution is observed by replacing the unlinked helper pathname with an exit-99 script before spawn; successful reaping still runs through inherited /proc/self/fd/4.
Two reaped processes are the direct target and its detached child. processTreeContained=false remains the recorded protocol result; no cgroup or complete containment claim.
No native package, CLI package or IDE extension was published; no website service or shared dependency was modified.
Raw executable binaries and patch payload remain temporary and are not committed; this receipt embeds small replay harnesses and hashes.
